label: B25-BRAM-MONITOR

rtl: SOC_BRAM_TOP/STACK constants now describe the fixed 64 KiB B25 window.
Behavioral BRAM defaults to 64 KiB; synthesis and standalone altera_syncram wrappers use WIDTH=64, 8192 words, an explicit init_file, and power_up_uninitialized=FALSE.
The existing BOOT_HEX_FILE SoC parameter carries the synthesis MIF path at the platform top while the behavioral path keeps the byte HEX ABI.
firmware: boot.S is a BRAM-resident monitor with bounded CAL-WAIT handling and no DDR branch.
Startup reports LCVEX25 BOOT, CAL-OK/CAL-FAIL/CAL-WAIT, DDR-OK/DDR-FAIL, and READY.
p, ?, m, and printable-byte polling commands are implemented; UART writes check CONTROL.WSPACE and drop the byte after a finite timeout without issuing a DATA access.
The DDR test writes five 16 KiB-spaced lines, forcing L1/L2 eviction/writeback for the current cache geometries before reading the first magic back.
image: bin_to_mif.py generates one-byte-per-line HEX and fully populated WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192 MIF with little-endian byte lane zero.
The generator verifies both HEX bytes and every padded MIF byte after writing.
